prompt: A 4-bit carry-lookahead adder adds A = `1011` and B = `0110` with carry in C0 of 0. Using generate Gi (Ai AND Bi) and propagate Pi (Ai XOR Bi), what is C4, and where does that carry come from?

options.text: Carry-out is zero, because no bit generates a carry
options.explanation: Bit 1 has A1 = B1 = 1, so G1 = 1. Check G = A AND B = `0010`.
G3 is A3 AND B3, which is 1 AND 0, so 0: bit 3 does not generate. It propagates (P3 is 1) a carry that started lower down.

options.text: carry-out set, generated at bit 1 and propagated through bits 2 and 3
options.explanation: Correct. Bit 1 generates a carry, and the unequal operand bits in columns 2 and 3 propagate it to the output.

options.text: carry-out set, from the carry in C0
options.explanation: The incoming carry is low, and bit 1 would not propagate it anyway. Bit 1 generates the carry itself.

workedExample: Inspect corresponding operand bits. Bit 1 has two ones and generates a carry. Bits 2 and 3 each have exactly one data bit high, so they propagate it. The original carry-in is low; the final carry therefore originates at bit 1, not at the top bit or the external input.

prompt: Bit zero generates a carry, but bit one has both operand bits low. Can that carry alone reach bit three?

options.text: No; bit one kills the incoming carry
options.explanation: Correct. Two low data bits plus an incoming carry produce a sum bit but no outgoing carry.

options.text: Yes; every generated carry reaches the top
Yes; lookahead ignores all intermediate bits
options.explanation: Lookahead computes the same carry function, including intervening conditions, more directly.

options.text: Only if every lower bit also generates a carry
options.explanation: One generate followed by propagates is sufficient; this case fails because of the killing column.

workedExample: Trace the route, not only its starting point. A lower generate matters at a target only when all intervening columns propagate. Lookahead evaluates that condition from the inputs; it cannot bypass a logically blocking column.
